tools.name: post_deal_won_webhook
tools.description: Sends a deal-won notification to the configured sales-ops webhook with the deal's name, amount, and owner. Does not change the deal in the CRM.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: ID of the deal that was won

tools.code:
import os
import requests

WEBHOOK_URL = os.environ.get("SALES_OPS_WEBHOOK_URL", "https://hooks.example.com/sales-ops")


def post_deal_won_webhook(deal_id, deal_name, amount, owner_email):
    payload = {
        "event": "deal.won",
        "deal_id": deal_id,
        "deal_name": deal_name,
        "amount": amount,
        "owner": owner_email,
    }
    resp = requests.post(WEBHOOK_URL, json=payload, timeout=10)
    result = {
        "deal_id": deal_id,
        "status_code": resp.status_code,
        "delivered": resp.ok,
    }
    return result

tools.name: refund_deal_and_move_to_lost
tools.description: Issues a refund for a deal's Stripe payment and moves the deal record from the active deals table to the closed_lost table. Refund amount can be partial or full.

tools.name: charge_and_email_deal_invoice
tools.description: Charges a contact's saved card through Stripe for a deal and emails the contact a receipt confirming the charge.

params.name: contact_email
params.description: Email of the contact to charge and notify

params.name: deal_name
params.description: Name of the deal being billed

tools.code:
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

import stripe
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def charge_and_email_deal_invoice(contact_email: str, customer_id: str, amount_cents: int, deal_name: str) -> dict:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"Deal: {deal_name}",
    )

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "billing@example.com"
    msg["To"] = contact_email
    msg["Subject"] = f"Receipt for {deal_name}"
    msg.set_content(f"We charged ${amount_cents / 100:.2f} for {deal_name}. Reference: {intent['id']}")

    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.example.com", 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.send_message(msg)

    result = {
        "payment_intent": intent["id"],
        "status": intent["status"],
        "receipt_sent_to": contact_email,
    }
    return result
